## Problem

What user or developer problem does this change address?

## Change

What changed, and why is this approach appropriate?

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] Behavior changes include tests
- [ ] Documentation and migrations are updated when needed
- [ ] Keyboard, mobile, light, and dark behavior were considered for UI changes

## Portability and self-hosting

- [ ] Exported Markdown remains portable
- [ ] Cloudflare and VPS behavior remain aligned, or the difference is documented
- [ ] No telemetry, secret, complete invitation link, or private document content is included

## Screenshots or notes

Add screenshots for visible changes or explain why they are unnecessary.
